about: THE NAME «מולדת אהובה» baked from the owner’s HazitHeavy (tools/ui/mainscreen/name_masks.py + name_bake.mjs): row 0 = the whole name [0, 0, w, h]; letters = each letter alone in reading order (the rightmost first), its cell in the sheet [sx, sy, w, h] and ox = its column in the whole name’s frame. base = the baseline row in the frame; body = the letter height.
